purpose: Evolve ranking of simultaneous qualifying Defensive trades under scarce capital without changing the frozen entry/exit mechanism.

frozen_trade_mechanism.exit: stock RSI14 >= q50 AND market 20-session return >= q35

allocator_genome.form: sparse linear rank score over causal signal-time features
features: OFR Funding lagged two business days
OFR Credit lagged two business days
allocator_genome.normalization: development-only robust percentile rank by feature

hard_rules: No future trade return, MFE, MAE, exit date or outcome may be an allocator feature.
No leverage and no pyramiding same ticker.
No TEST17, preserved50, remaining Discovery, Verification A or Verification B.

transport.method: heldout_episode_excluded_from allocator feature normalization and fitness
heldout result cannot alter fold genome
all six folds reported including failures
